records.answer:
Definition: Lapse rate is the share of month-M active buyers who made no purchase in month M+1 (used as a churn proxy since there is no subscription data).

Trend: As shown in the historical data, the monthly lapse rate remains near-total across all six evaluated transitions (99.33% to 100%). Because repeat purchases in consecutive months are extremely rare in this dataset, a one-month churn spike is not informative.

Limitations: Month-over-month lapse rates carry very little signal when baseline repeat purchase rates are near zero.

Next Steps: Monitor active buyer counts and returning-buyer share over time rather than short-term lapse rates.
